This [[uniform polyhedron compound]] is a composition of the 2 [[enantiomers]] of the [[snub cube]]. As a holosnub, it is represented by [[Schläfli symbol]] &beta;r{4,3} and [[Coxeter diagram]] {{CDD|node_h3|4|node_h3|3|node_h3}}.

The [[vertex arrangement]] of this compound is shared by a convex nonuniform [[truncated cuboctahedron]], having rectangular faces, alongside irregular [[hexagon]]s and [[octagon]]s, each alternating with two edge lengths.

Together with its convex hull, it represents the snub cube-first projection of the nonuniform [[Truncated cuboctahedral prism#Related polytopes|snub cubic antiprism]].

==Cartesian coordinates==
[[Cartesian coordinates]] for the [[vertex (geometry)|vertices]] are all the [[permutation]]s of
:(±1, ±''ξ'', ±1/''ξ'')

where ''ξ'' is the real solution to
:<math>\xi^3+\xi^2+\xi=1, \,</math>

which can be written
:<math>\xi = \frac{1}{3}\left(\sqrt[3]{17+3\sqrt{33}} - \sqrt[3]{-17+3\sqrt{33}} - 1\right)</math>

or approximately 0.543689. ξ is the reciprocal of the [[tribonacci constant]].

Equally, the tribonacci constant, ''t'', just like the [[Snub_cube#Cartesian_coordinates|snub cube]], can compute the coordinates as the permutations of:
:(±1, ±{{sfrac|1|''t''}}, ±''t'')

== Truncated cuboctahedron ==
This compound can be seen as the union of the two chiral alternations of a [[truncated cuboctahedron]]:
:[[File:Snubcubes in grCO.svg|480px]][[File:TRIBONACCI.jpg|thumb|A geometric construction of the Tribonacci constant (AC), with compass and marked ruler, according to the method described by Xerardo Neira.]]
